The '''NA LCS 2014 Spring''' split was the first split of the 2014 North American [[LCS|League of Legends Championship Series]] season, organized by Riot Games and held from January 16 to April 20, 2014, in Los Angeles, United States. Eight teams competed in a double round-robin Regular Season, with all matches being best-of-one. The top six teams advanced to the Playoffs, which were played in a Single Elimination Best-of-Five format. The winner of the split qualified for the [[All-Star/2014|2014 All-Star Invitational]] and earned championship points toward qualification for the [[World_Championship/2014|2014 World Championship]]. The total prize pool for the event was US$100,000.
